data.spiritual_significance: Ikha holds deep spiritual significance in Islam as it represents the concept of rewards and blessings bestowed upon individuals by Allah for their good deeds. It serves as a reminder of the idea that every action has a consequence, and that by striving to be good, kind, and compassionate, an individual may receive a great reward in this life and the next. The name Ikha therefore symbolizes the hope and aspiration for a righteous and virtuous life filled with blessings and divine favor.
